verdict.rationale: Digits documents its own developer sandbox: each developer gets a resettable demo instance with realistic pre-loaded data, and OAuth flows invoked with Development keys automatically select the demo client, keeping testing separate from real ledgers. The API page also promises a sandbox so developers can "test freely". This is a true isolated sandbox environment, not a dry-run mode. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the demo instance is fully isolated from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Each developer has access to their own resettable demo instance, illustrating both an accounting firm and a client.
The OAuth authorization flow will automatically select your demo client when invoked with Development keys.
Digits has a demo environment with realistic data pre-loaded from other connections.
Full OpenAPI spec & sandbox — Generate clients, test freely, and deploy with confidence.
